subject: Remove redundant function `nextPingExt()` (#613)
reason: The change deletes the duplicate function nextPingExt() and replaces its four call sites in writePingExt() with the pre-existing getNextPingExt(). Both functions compute the identical expression ((char *)ext + ntohl(ext->length)) — getNextPingExt just goes through the getPingExtLength() accessor, which is a one-line ntohl(ext->length). No cluster-bus message layout, size computation, or parsing behaviour changes; this is a pure dead-code/deduplication refactor with no observable behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
